summary: Van Hodges, 48, of Enid, Oklahoma, died after being ejected from a commercial Royal George Rafting raft that hit rough water near the Salt Lick Recreation Site (U.S. 50 mile marker 259) in Bighorn Sheep Canyon; he was one of five people thrown from the seven-person raft
location: Salt Lick Recreation Site, U.S. 50 mile marker 259, Bighorn Sheep Canyon
responding_agency: Royal George Rafting trip party; local emergency responders (not named in source)
notes: Mountain Mail 'River claims six lives' 2014 season roundup parent-opened this run; first of the six accidents, 'June 10'.
